research.question: Why did Intel pause the Magdeburg fab in September 2024 and cancel it entirely in July 2025, and what did each party's judgement rest on?
research.decision_context: Test case for the A-vs-B comparison. Not commissioned by anyone; no decision depends on it.
scope_in: German federal subsidy and budget politics
scope_out: TSMC/ESMC capacity plans except as comparison
